name: Collar
long_description:
Collar helps public companies take back control of the stock market.

All public companies interface with the markets through investor relations. 
With good investor relations, any stock can soar. The power dynamics shift. 
But most management teams are small, and most IR officers are non-strategic.

Collar automates 64% of the investor relations work. It helps management run end to end IR conversations, access unique intelligence, brings up citation-backed talking points for their confidential investor Q&A. 

We replace the $15K/month IR agencies, and help existing IR teams fundraise at the speed of AI. 
Currently at 67% week over week growth in client engagements.

We are a team of ex-intelligence, ex-finance, and repeat founders who have known each other for over 5 years, serving enterprises across the US, Asia and LATAM.
one_liner: AI-Native Investor Relations For Public Companies
